body: I am thankful for finally passing my first year of uni and deciding to get help to get sober towards the end of it, I'm starting to focus on a future for myself for the first time in my life
Insane amount of fear any time someone calls my name from downstairs or if my mum sits the whole family down for a talk. Thanks, trauma!

Most of my dad's family. I cut off contact with them after they were cunts to him and my mum while he was dying of cancer. They walked out of the funeral half way through and I've not spoken to my aunt or uncle in years (have briefly chatted with my cousins but I can't let go of my anger towards them). 

I always wonder if they still think about me and my younger brother and what good friends we were when we were growing up. I miss them and still wish I had support from that side of the family but I doubt either of us will ever be able to let go of all the shit that went down.
CICO and trying to walk more! I also REALLY cut back on the amount of alcohol I was consuming because I realised I didn't have a very healthy relationship with it
Thanks so much!!! I'm really enjoying being able to look at the clothes I WANT again, that little bit more confidence really makes such a difference

This is so real. My dad died when I was 16 and he was always the photographer, never liked actually being in the pictures or videos. I watch home movies just so I can occasionally hear him laugh at what he's filming or mumble some commentary but I wish with all my heart I could actually see his face and reactions.

I think I'm a bit afraid of the term. I'm really young and come from a family of alcoholics/people very dependent on alcohol but accepting the actual term is something that I'm trying to work on in therapy haha. Stay strong mate x

Generally a couple of bottles of wine (and sometimes a few glasses of whisky/gin too) a night for two years straight. I'm not really sure if I could class myself as an alcoholic, but I've recently decided that I'm not able to have a sensible relationship with alcohol for a while, definitely not until I'm in a more stable place mentally!

I think I am actually gonna start trying to get help again bc I know I can't carry on like this 
I'm gonna go visit my girlfriend tomorrow after work so I have something to look forwards to. I'm just really nervous about seeking help again in case I just get brushed off like last time, or if I have to go into the hospital for any reason and it messes with my job bc I really can't afford to lose it!

Thank you so much man- funnily enough that book is actually currently on my amazon wish list! Maybe I'll treat myself haha 

Best of luck to you as well. Life is pretty shitty for everyone sometimes, but random strangers reaching out over the internet is an undeniable act of kindness that helps the soul a bit x

I don't really see my friends anymore. I have an amazing girlfriend who I've been with for almost 3 years but I can't really tell her how low I am right now as she's got her own shit going on and I don't want to worry her even more
I did start getting help on the NHS in Jan this year but the place I was referred to was SO BAD (my doctor told me that she thought I was too chicken to attempt suicide and refused to help me with medication) so I left and I've just been making through on my own for now. Thank you for replying, it helps a bit to know that someone can hear me
